summary: 3 film announcements, 2 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Supermax
film.announcement: Jason Clarke joins the action-thriller as a cast member. The film is in development from Amazon MGM Studios and Miramax.

film.title: Spring Breakers 2
film.announcement: Bella Thorne has been tapped to write, direct, and star in the sequel after the original producers saw her directorial debut.

film.title: Artificial
film.announcement: Monica Barbaro stars in director Luca Guadagnino's film produced in partnership with OpenAI.

tv.title: Boston Blue
tv.announcement: Will Estes, an alum of 'Blue Bloods,' is reprising his role on the series.

tv.title: Monsters Of God
tv.announcement: A reptilian docuseries from 'Tiger King' creator Eric Goode is coming to HBO.
